name: item_id
description: Unique item key

name: lot_id
description: Truckload / lot key

name: category
description: Product category

name: brand_tier
description: Premium / mid / generic brand tier

name: condition
description: Graded condition after testing

name: retail_value
description: Recorded retail value from the catalog match (denominator of recovery rate)

name: log_retail_value
description: Log of recorded retail value

name: match_confidence
description: Confidence of the Amazon/Walmart catalog match

name: product_age_years
description: Years since the product model was released

name: title
description: Product title (text features)

name: matched_title
description: Title of the catalog entry matched to the item

name: return_reason
description: Reason code from the original return

name: weight_class
description: 0 tiny .. 4 bulky; drives shipping and holding cost

name: photo_count
description: Number of listing photos

name: receipt_to_listing_days
description: Days between receiving the item and listing it

name: start_bid_pct
description: Opening bid as a share of retail value

name: auction_duration_days
description: Scheduled auction length

name: end_dow
description: Day of week the auction ends (0=Mon)

name: end_hour
description: Hour the auction ends

name: simultaneous_listings
description: Items of the same category listed in the same week (supply glut)

name: listing_moy
description: Calendar month of listing (seasonality)

name: listing_dow
description: Day of week of listing

name: source_id
description: Where the lot was bought

name: source_type
description: Type of source (big-box returns, closeout, broker, ...)

name: region
description: Sourcing region (new regions appear with the national expansion)

name: manifest_flag
description: Lot arrived with an itemized manifest

name: acquisition_rate
description: Lot price divided by lot retail value

name: lot_item_count
description: Items in the lot

name: pilot_arm
description: Randomized channel arm: fixed / auction / not_eligible

name: premium_pct
description: Randomized premium over the expected auction price

name: photo_arm
description: Randomized extra-photo arm: none / control / extra

name: handling_minutes
description: Warehouse minutes spent on the item

name: fees
description: Payment and marketplace fees

name: shipping_cost
description: Shipping subsidy (plus return shipping on refunds)

name: holding_days
description: Days the item occupied the warehouse

name: bidders
description: Number of bidders (known only after the auction)

name: watchers
description: Watchers while listed (time-varying; excluded from listing-time models)

name: sale_price
description: Price paid by the buyer

name: sold
description: Item sold

name: refund_flag
description: Sale was refunded
